title: Future Tense — Perfective
grammarPoint: Perfective future: present-looking conjugation of perfective verbs (napiszę, zrobię, kupię) = future meaning

explanation.text:
Perfective verbs do NOT have a true present tense. Their **present-looking conjugation** is actually **future tense**.

**Key insight:** When you conjugate a perfective verb in the 'present', it means FUTURE.

**Examples — perfective future forms:**

| Infinitive | ja | ty | on/ona | my | wy | oni/one |
|-----------|----|----|--------|----|----|--------|
| napisać | **napiszę** | **napiszesz** | **napisze** | **napiszemy** | **napiszecie** | **napiszą** |
| zrobić | **zrobię** | **zrobisz** | **zrobi** | **zrobimy** | **zrobicie** | **zrobią** |
| kupić | **kupię** | **kupisz** | **kupi** | **kupimy** | **kupicie** | **kupią** |
| pójść | **pójdę** | **pójdziesz** | **pójdzie** | **pójdziemy** | **pójdziecie** | **pójdą** |

**Imperfective vs. Perfective future:**

| | Imperfective future | Perfective future |
|-|--------------------|-----------------|
| Form | będę + infinitive | present-looking form |
| Meaning | will be doing (ongoing) | will do (completed) |
| Example | Będę czytać | Przeczytam |

**Context examples:**
- Jutro **napiszę** e-mail. = Tomorrow I'll write [and send] the email. (completed)
- Jutro będę pisać e-maile. = Tomorrow I'll be writing emails. (ongoing, many)
- **Zrobię** to dziś wieczorem. = I'll do it tonight. (completed promise)
- Gdzie **pójdziemy** w weekend? = Where will we go at the weekend?
notes: Perfective present-looking form = FUTURE. 'Napiszę' = I will write [finish writing].
No 'będę' needed for perfective future — the conjugation itself carries the future meaning.
Use perfective future for: completed future events, promises, results.
Use imperfective future for: ongoing/habitual/background future activity.

exercises.prompt: Jutro ___ ten raport. (Tomorrow I will finish [write] this report.) [napisać, ja]
exercises.explanation: Single completed future event → perfective future: napiszę. 'Będę pisać' (imperfective) = I'll be writing — ongoing, not necessarily finishing.

exercises.prompt: Ona ___ zakupy jutro rano. (She will do the shopping tomorrow morning.) [zrobić, ona perfective future]
'Kupisz mi chleb?' — What does this mean?
options: Will you buy me some bread?
Did you buy me some bread?
Are you buying me some bread?
You used to buy me bread.
exercises.explanation: 'Kupisz' = perfective future of 'kupić' (ty). Present-looking form of a perfective verb = future in Polish. 'Kupisz mi chleb?' = Will you buy me some bread?

exercises.prompt: Build: We will go to the cinema on Saturday. (perfective future — pójść)
exercises.explanation: 'Pójdziemy do kina w sobotę.' — We will go to the cinema on Saturday. 'Pójść' perfective future: pójdziemy. 'Do kina' = genitive destination. 'W sobotę' = on Saturday.

exercises.prompt: Choose the perfective future to express 'I'll call you after work.' [zadzwonić, ja]
options: Będę dzwonić do ciebie po pracy.
exercises.explanation: Single completed future call = perfective: zadzwonię. 'Będę dzwonić' = imperfective future (I'll be calling — ongoing). 'Zadzwonię po pracy' = I'll call [once, completed] after work.
